title: Fish Kofta
steps: Fish Mixture:
Put cilantro stems and 1 jalapeno in food processor. Pulse, not completely blend. Put in a separate bowl.
Slice catfish filets into thirds and put in food processor. Pulse, but more finely than the cilantro mix.
Put cumin, coriander and red pepper powder in a bowl. Mix with ginger and garlic paste (around 1 tbsp per 6 filets) add to filet mixture.
Add besan flour to the mixture.
Add 2 eggs (per 6 filet).
Form into small balls and deep fry.
Gravy:
Add 1 onion or onion paste, ½ jalapeno to food processor to finely dice.
Add a lot of vegetable oil to a pot with cumin seed and dried red peppers for “aroma”.
Add in onion/jalapeno to the oil.
Create spice mixture- black pepper, cumin, fresh coriander, garam masala (homemade).
Add spices to onion/jalapeno mix once browned.
Add a couple crushed Italian tomatoes to the mixture.
Mix together almond flour with cold water. Add yogurt to this mixture. Add to full gravy mixture on the stovetop.
Mix the fried fish balls with the gravy mixture, add water so they are all covered.
When you see separation of the oil then it is ready to be served.

title: Black Chana
steps: Soak black chana beans overnight.
Cover beans in water in the pressure cooker and put over heat to soften for 30 minutes.
While bean cooks cut 1 onion into thin slices and cut peeled potato into thin cubes.
Let cubed potatoes soak in water so they don’t oxidize.
Add potatoes to the black chana beans w/water from the beans- cook until water is completely evaporated.
Add 1 spoonful of ghee and vegetable oil.
Add in spice mixture: cumin, turmeric, chana masala, ginger garlic paste can add some dried red peppers.
Add in thinly sliced onions.
Add a little bit of rose water.
Keep on the heat for 10-15 minutes.

title: Crispy Fried Fish with Combination Fruits
steps: Cover fish of choice (filet) with cornstarch and deep-fry in oil.
Take fish out and put on separate plate.
In a separate pan, saute garlic in oil and add fruit mixture of choice- normally mango, pineapple, banana, strawberries, peach, cook on high flame.
Add sweet and spicy sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce and ½ tbsp brown sugar.
Add green onion at the end (don’t overcook to keep green color).
Cook until all water evaporated and dried out/oil is separated from rest of the fruits.
Pour on top of crispy fried fish and serve immediately.
notes: Do not cook dish ahead of time. Should be 10-15 minutes before scheduled dinner. If served late the fish gets soggy and less crispy.

title: Lahori Chickpeas
description: Lahor is a city in Pakistan.
steps: Paste medium sized onion in the food processor and put aside.
Boil medium sized potato and paste it in the food processor, set aside.
Paste a cup of chickpeas and put aside.
In a pot, add oil, when oil is heated add the onion paste, then add ginger/garlic paste, coriander, cumin powder and green chiles and red chile powder.
Add ½ cup of water and cook so spices are not burned.
When water is completely evaporated, add the onion paste, chickpea paste and ½ cup yogurt.
Add salt to taste.
Cook until water is evaporated.
Then add whole canned chickpeas and ½ cup of water and cook on low flame.

title: Babaganoush
ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt (2 tbsp per eggplant)
steps: Roast 1-2 eggplants (stove, oven, grill)- the best is on the grill for smoky flavor.
After the eggplants are well-cooked, spoon out the inner part of the eggplant and put in a strainer to get rid of excess water.
After draining, add eggplant to a big bowl.
Squeeze 1 lemon, 2 tablespoons of tahini per medium-sized eggplant, 2 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt per medium sized-eggplant, 2 large cloves of shredded garlic, salt to taste.
Mix by hand.
Put on flat plate and decorate with black pepper, sumac, paprika.
Put in refrigerator and serve with olive oil.

title: Mixed Vegetables
steps: Fry medium sized onion in a pot, saute until brown.
Add garlic slice fresh.
Add tablespoon of ginger/garlic paste, coriander and cumin, 1 tsp turmeric.
Put flame down otherwise it will get burned.
Add tandoori masala.
Add vegetables you want- potatoes, fresh tomatoes, cauliflower (frozen), green beans (frozen), snow peas (frozen), ½ green cabbage.
Since these are frozen vegetables don’t put any water.
Add salt as needed and mix well.
Cook on high flame with no lid for 5-10 min until all water evaporated.
Then keep vegetables on low flame with lid for 15 min until all cooked.
notes: Alternative versions: okra and potato; badamjoon + potato + pea version (onions go in last).

title: Okra Stew with Beef
steps: Put meat in a pressure cooker for 30 min with water and garlic cloves.
Saute frozen okra with lemon juice.
Slice onions and saute with oil until brown.
Add spice mix: garam masala, coriander, cumin, ginger/garlic paste.
Put on low flame when adding spices.
Add whole peeled Italian tomatoes.
Add 2 tablespoons whole milk yogurt.
Add meat and sauteed okra to the sauce.
Add water from pressure cooker and simmer on low flame for 10-15 min.

title: Mowgli Parata
steps: Mix regular flour with yogurt and some milk to make dough.
Add salt and pinch of baking soda.
Cover the dough in dark place for 2 hours.
Make a square with the dough and fold filling inside.
Fry in a pan with ghee.
notes: Do not use too much baking soda or it will fluff too much.

title: Keema Aloo
description: Ground meat with potato cubes and sweet peas.
steps: Thinly slice onion and fry it with oil until it becomes brown.
Reduce the flame to a minimum.
In a cup, take mixture of onion.
In a separate bowl take 1 tbsp garlic paste, 1 tbsp ginger paste, freshly minced coriander and cumin powder, ½ tbsp black pepper, few dried red chili.
Mix this with onion and cook slowly, add water from time to time to avoid burning.
Add ground beef- 70 meat/30 fat with potato cubes and sweet peas.
Cook at medium flame until potatoes are all soft.
After completely cooked, take another fry pan with 1 tbsp of ghee, thinly sliced onion- fry onions until brown.
Add as garnish on top, can mix.
Serve nicely.

title: Ketchup Chicken
steps: Fry sliced shallots (2) until totally brown with ghee. Take out and put to the side for the end.
Fry chicken in oil on high flame.
Prepare spice mixture: black pepper, coriander, cumin, red pepper.
Buy coriander and cumin seeds, wash them, roast them and grind them.
Add 2 tablespoons of garlic paste and ginger paste.
Make cashew flour paste using raw cashews or almond flour mixed with water.
Slice 1 red onion and add to chicken once browned.
Add in spices.
When onion is soft, add cashew/almond flour paste and whole milk plain yogurt.
In a separate pan add ketchup and oil.
Add the fried shallots mixture.
Add 1 spoon of brown sugar.
Add this mixture to the chicken mixture.
Sprinkle garam masala at the end.
Keep covered in the pot for a little bit to make sure it’s cooked.
notes: Optional at beginning: bay leaf, cardamom seed, cinnamon stick. Baba doesn’t like this, but Mommy does.

title: Egg Masala
steps: Hard boil eggs.
Put eggs in fry pan until brown on all sides.
Remove from pan and put aside.
Fry sliced red onion in the pan.
Add coriander, cumin, red pepper, black pepper, garlic paste, ginger paste.
Add in sliced tomato and green pepper.
Cook until moist, add water as needed.
Add eggs back in and mix.
notes: Masala = dried. Boona = jelly-like. Curry = water-like.

title: Pulao Rice
steps: Fry 1 stick of butter and add washed rice and stir for 5-10 minutes until some grains become brown.
For each cup of rice add 1.5 cups of water.
Use chicken broth cubes or vegetable broth cube.
Put it in the rice cooker.
Add peas.

title: Murghee Masala
steps: Fry chicken in a ton of oil with a little bit of salt at high temperature.
Add in very thinly sliced white onion.
Add in spice mix: red pepper, black pepper, coriander, cumin, kashmiri pepper, ginger and garlic paste.
Turn the temperature down to low so that the spices don’t burn.
Add in thick slices of red onion and the tomatoes.
Add 2 tablespoons of greek yogurt.
Bring the temperature down to medium, cover and cook for around 10 minutes.
notes: Don’t add water or else it will be like Mommy’s cooking.

title: Chicken Karahi
description: Karahi is like an Indian wok.
steps: Fry in oil cumin seed, coriander seeds and little green peppers on high.
Add in chicken small cuts of chicken.
Add in the masala: ginger and garlic paste, turmeric, kashmiri pepper, cumin, coriander, black pepper.
Add some water if needed.
Add in onions and sliced tomatoes at the end and cover.
Put on a HIGH flame.
You will know it is done when the oil separates from the water.

title: Mangsho Karai
steps: Put beef in the pressure cooker for 30 minutes with cardamom to make it tender.
Add in sliced red onion and spice mix.
Add cumin, coriander, lots of kashmiri pepper, ginger and garlic paste.
Add in sliced large tomato.
Add in yogurt.
Turn down the flame and cover for 20 minutes.
notes: Baba added two full sticks of butter. Ghee is better.

title: Mach Masala
steps: In a pan put green pepper, coriander and cumin seed and fry with onion.
Chop catfish into smaller pieces.
Prepare spices: cumin, coriander powder, turmeric, kashmiri pepper, red and black pepper, garlic paste, salt.
Add water while cooking spices.
Add in sliced tomato.
Add in fish and mix WELL.
Once cooked, do not stir or fish will fall apart.

title: Khoresh Bademjan
steps: Prepare saffron by soaking it in water or microwaving briefly, then strain.
Salt eggplants and let sit for at least 15 minutes, rinse and pat dry.
Roast eggplants in oven to soften.
Fry and soften onions.
Add chicken, turmeric, salt and black pepper.
Fry together until slightly brown.
Add tomato paste and tomatoes.
Add lemon juice.
Add saffron water for Iranian taste.
Cook on medium or medium-low heat.
Toward the end, add eggplant.
Cook for at least one hour, preferably closer to one and a half hours.
notes: Tomato cannot be cooked on high heat or it will burn.

title: Baghali Polo
steps: Make white rice.
Put thin slices of potato at the bottom of the pan with oil, coriander, salt and pepper.
Layer rice on top.
Add a layer of lima beans.
Add a layer of dill.
Add another layer of rice and dill.
Bake at 270 degrees for 60 minutes.
Add caramelized onions on top.

title: Lebanese Spinach Pies (Fatayer)
steps: Mix yeast with 1 teaspoon sugar.
Add 1.5 cups water.
Add 3 cups flour and stir.
Punch and squeeze the dough 200 times.
Keep adding white flour as needed.
Dice onions and fry in oil until brown.
Add garlic cloves and lightly fry.
Add red chili flakes and salt.
Add frozen spinach and parsley.
Add lemon and sumac.
Fill dough and bake.

title: Havij Polo (Shirin Polo / Carrot Rice)
steps: Fry onions.
Add ground beef, cinnamon, turmeric and black pepper.
Fry matchstick carrots separately.
Fry raisins separately.
Cook rice in salted water and drain.
Layer rice, meat, carrots and raisins.
Add saffron water if desired.
Bake at 295 degrees for up to one hour.
notes: Raisins burn quickly. Saffron is optional.

title: Pickle Chicken
steps: Fry onions and potatoes with bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric, black pepper, red pepper.
Add garlic and ginger paste.
Add pickle (1-2 spoons).
Add small chicken pieces.
Fry together generously with oil.
Put lid on and add tomatoes.
notes: Ginger won’t burn but garlic will, so add garlic right before chicken.

title: Green Bean Rice (Loobia Polo)
steps: Fry onion.
Add small pieces of meat and cook around 2 hours.
Add turmeric and black pepper.
Optional: dash of cinnamon.
Add tomato sauce or paste near the end.
Roast green beans in oven with oil, salt and pepper.
Add green beans to meat mixture.
Dry mixture so rice is not soggy.
Cook rice in salted water and drain.
Add saffron water to rice if desired.
Bake in oven at 295-300 for about one hour.
notes: Some people make it vegetarian or cook meat separately.

title: Tachin Joojeh
steps: Fry onions.
Add turmeric, black pepper and salt.
Slow cook chicken until cooked through.
Cool chicken and shred.
Cook rice to al dente and drain.
Prepare saffron with hot water.
Mix egg yolk with yogurt.
Oil casserole dish.
Mix or layer rice, yogurt mixture, chicken and onions.
Bake at 300-350 degrees until bottom is golden brown.
notes: Takes around an hour and a half.

title: Albaloo Polo
steps: Fry onions.
Add frozen sour cherries.
Cook together briefly.
Prepare meatballs with grated onion, salt, turmeric and black pepper.
Cook meatballs slowly on low flame.
Prepare rice and saffron separately.
Layer rice, cherries and meatballs.
Bake at 295 degrees for about an hour.

title: Abgoosht
steps: Put lamb shank, onion slices, chickpeas, turmeric, tomato paste, salt and black pepper in pressure cooker.
Add lots of water.
Add dried limes with holes poked in them.
Add cilantro and garlic powder if desired.
Cook for 2 hours.
Transfer to pot and add large potato cubes.
Slightly smash potatoes to thicken soup.

title: Baba’s Common Salad
steps: Dice tomatoes and red onion.
Chop a lot of fresh cilantro.
Mix everything together in a bowl.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice on top.
Add salt to taste and mix well.

title: Tandoori Chicken
steps: Cut chicken and slice deeply so spices can go inside. Do not remove skin.
Make the masala: mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, sweetened date tamarind sauce, and tandoori masala.
Apply masala to both sides of the chicken.
Preheat oven to 500°F on broil.
Broil chicken, turning as needed, until fully cooked and charred. Takes around 1 hour.

title: Chingri Malai
steps: Peel shrimp and make sure they are completely dry.
Brown onions slightly, then add potato cubes.
Add garlic paste, ginger paste, cumin, coriander and a small amount of turmeric.
Turn flame down and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add chunks of tomatoes.
When tomatoes melt and oil separates, add ½ cup water.
Add shrimp and peas together and cook on low flame for 10 minutes.
Increase flame to dry the curry so shrimp are not soggy.
Garnish with ginger or coriander leaves.

title: Begoon, Aloo Ebong Chingri
steps: Cook peas and potato cubes with onion and eggplant in a pan. Do not make eggplant mushy.
Add cumin, garlic paste, turmeric, coriander and tomato sauce.
Cook on HIGH flame.
In a separate pan, sauté shrimp in butter.
Mix shrimp into vegetable mixture and garnish.

title: Bihari Kebab
ingredients: beef (very thin slices or small cubes)
steps: Fry onions until brown. No garlic.
Add ginger paste, salt, cumin and coriander powder and cook briefly.
Blend fried onions with LOTS of yogurt, lemon juice, coriander and green pepper.
Add 1 tablespoon papaya paste.
After mixture cools, add Bihari masala.
Spread masala on each meat slice and stack them.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Next day, cook uncovered on pan, oven or charcoal with very little oil.
notes: Best cooked on charcoal. Do not cover while cooking or meat will release water.

title: Arvi Chingri Johl
steps: Sauté shrimp in lots of oil until crunchy. Remove and set aside.
Brown onions in pan.
Prepare spices: garlic paste, kashmiri pepper, red pepper, black pepper, cumin and coriander.
Add spices to onions with some water and lower flame.
Add arvi and a LOT of water to make curry.

title: Murghi Rezala
steps: Fry chicken in ghee until slightly brown.
Add raw onion paste.
Cook until onion browns and water releases from chicken.
Add garlic and ginger paste.
Cook until oil separates.
Add raisins or apricots.
Add cashew paste mixed with yogurt and cook on low flame.
Add sliced green pepper.
Top with caramelized onions.

title: Chaat / Chola Masala
steps: Pressure cook chickpeas and potato cubes for 3 whistles.
Dice tomatoes, red onion and cilantro.
Smash some potatoes and chickpeas to make sauce.
Add everything including cooking water to bowl.
Mix in chola masala and date tamarind chutney.

title: Aunti Koori’s Daal
steps: Put red lentils and raw onions in pressure cooker.
Add garlic paste, ginger paste, coriander, red pepper powder, whole red peppers, turmeric and cumin.
Add salt and water.
Cook until lentils are soft.
Fry onions in ghee and add on top.

title: Baba’s Daal
steps: Put water, tomatoes, onion, turmeric, salt and lentils into pot or pressure cooker.
Cook until everything melts together.
Fry remaining onion in ghee until brown but not caramelized.
Add chopped garlic and fry until fragrant.
Pour garlic mixture over daal.
Add handful of cilantro.
